real_qa.q: How did the NAFTA renegotiation achieve bipartisan support in the first Trump administration?
real_qa.r: CJ Mahoney explains that the renegotiation succeeded by accommodating both Democratic and Republican priorities, particularly labor standards in Mexico, which appealed to Trump's new coalition of Reagan Democrats as well as traditional Democrats concerned with unfair labor advantages.
